title: Angie Claude authentication circuit is open

model.expr: (max(angie_account_auth_breaker_open_accounts) or vector(0)) + (max(angie_auth_global_breaker_open) or vector(0)) + (max(1 - angie_auth_breaker_store_available) or vector(0))

annotations.description: Angie's persistent Claude authentication breaker is open or its state store is unavailable. One original account may be isolated and fresh work gets at most one replacement attempt; two distinct confirmed account failures open the global breaker and queue new pool work. Re-authenticate an account on the Angie Mac, source angie.env, then run scripts/accounts.py recover <name>. The command verifies the exact login before atomically closing the account/global breaker. Plain reset cannot close it.
annotations.summary: Angie Claude authentication circuit is open
